text:
zoe: Pushed nova-int8 to canary. Quick flag: funcall schema lints spiked. sample below.

lin: paste the raw output? parse error or subtle?

zoe: Not hard parse fail. Valid JSON mostly but trailing commas and sometimes an extra comma before closing brace. Example: ```json {"action":"add_label", "args":{"label":"bug",}, "tools":[] } ```

ben_rowe: trailing comma -> our strict schema linter fails. Seen this before with other quant canaries.

lin: telemetry shows funcall_parse_fail_rate 0.4% -> 4.8% after this model. highest on short prompts that end with toolcall suffix.

zoe: I ran local repro: noisy but reproducible ~2-4%. token dump shows comma as separate token at boundary.

ben_rowe: two immediate options: 1) lightweight post-parse repair (strip trailing commas, close braces) and surface repaired=true; 2) change finish decoding bias for funcalls to prefer end-of-structure tokens.

lin: prefer repair hook as opt-in for canary. also add telemetry field original_parse_status and repaired=true/false so we don't mask model regressions.

ci-bot: deploy-notice: canary nova-int8 at 2024-06-02T14:22:00Z. logs: s3://canary/nova-int8/17555566/logs.tgz

zoe: I'll PR the opt-in repair hook tonight and add smoke eval: rerun 5k funcall prompts to measure repaired hit-rate.

ben_rowe: Also open an experiment to test per-channel vs per-tensor quant to see differences in punctuation tokenization.

lin: agreed. keep repair opt-in until we find root cause. tagging ben for quant experiments. :thumbsup:
